content:
jamal: incidentbot just stopped paging for several pagerproxy routes, we're seeing repeated suppressions
incidentbot: suppression window triggered: detector=concurrency_leak, suppressed_count=24, window=00:00:12
sophia: customer reported no page and opened a support ticket :grimacing:
eli: digging in logs — suppressor counters never decremented after a deploy, race on ack-check path
maria: can we flip suppressor to passive to stop further suppression while we triage?
jamal: on it -> `./opsctl feature-toggle set suppressor passive --scope=pagerproxy`
ops-bot: Executing toggle: success (req=0x9aef), new_state=passive
sophia: testing with a synthetic to confirm paging works now
eli: run `curl -X POST https://pagerflow.local/testpage -d '{"service":"ingress","severity":"P2"}'` to trigger
maria: confirmed — oncall rotation got the page :thumbsup: @oncall-rotation
jamal: good, that unblocks customers. Root cause looks like a concurrency counter leak when multiple ack checks interleave
sophia: reproduced locally in staging with 20 concurrent requests, counter stays >0 and suppressor refuses to clear
eli: patch ready: add mutex around counter update + TTL to auto-clear stale entries, small binary change
maria: can we hotpatch? prefer canary first
eli: will canary in us-west-2 only, then rollout if metrics look normal
jamal: creating canary deploy, notifying SRE to watch paging metrics
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: deploy-id=deploy-2026-03-18-17677 target=us-west-2
sophia: keep suppressor disabled in config until canary verifies
eli: confirming logs: /var/log/incidentbot/suppressor.log shows repeating `counter not decremented` errors during the window
jamal: manual mitigation for missed pages: `./pagerctl resend --since 1767777600 --filter=suppressed` (one-off)
maria: resends triggered and we're getting delivery confirmations now
sophia: impact summary for execs: ~3 customers called support, no data loss, impact is missed pages (P2) but could have been P1 if high severity alerts suppressed
eli: filing follow-up to add healthcheck and auto-ttl detection for suppressed-rate anomalies
jamal: created RN-5412: "suppression counter leak + auto-ttl healthcheck" and linked runbook
ops-bot: RN-5412 created: https://go/repo/issues/RN-5412
sophia: post-mortem note: avoid changing suppressor semantics in release window without cross-team canary + runbook review
maria: once canary passes we'll re-enable default suppressor with the fixed binary and monitor for 1h of healthy metrics
oncall-rotation: acknowledged, will escalate immediately if paging degrades again
jamal: we'll close after 1h stable metrics and attach logs + resend audit to the ticket
sophia: thanks everyone :heart:
